caption_L1: Breakdown of NASA 's budget and how it was distributed from 2010 to 2020 (in million U.S dollars) is a line chart. Along the x-axis, Year is defined using a linear scale of range 2010 to 2018. A linear scale of range 0 to 6,000 can be found on the y-axis, labeled Space Exploration.
caption_L2L3: The diagram shows an upward trend between 2010 and 2020, although it is not a steady trend.  Spend stayed steady between 2010 and 2014 at just under 4,000 million dollars.  Spending increased in 2015 above 4,000 then reduced in 2016 to 4,000. From then on, there is a steady increase year-on-year, with an expectation that spend will go above 6,000 by 2020.
